description: This file defines enums related to onboarding states and connection modes for an iOS application, along with static methods for managing onboarding progress using UserDefaults.

methods.name: shouldPresentOnLaunch
methods.description: Determines whether onboarding should be presented on app launch based on onboarding completion status, last connection settings, and app model.

methods.name: markCompleted
methods.description: Marks onboarding as completed and records the mode and timestamp.

methods.name: shouldPresentFirstRunIntro
methods.description: Checks if the first run introduction has been seen.

methods.name: markFirstRunIntroSeen
methods.description: Marks that the first run introduction has been viewed.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets onboarding completion and first run intro flags.

methods.name: lastMode
methods.description: Retrieves the last connection mode from UserDefaults, if any.
